_note: The following lists Yale Special Collections ArchivesSpace repositories that a collection can belong to. This file is read while a YCAR record is being built, to turn the repository number in a spreadsheet's resource URI into the name a reader sees, and to list the repositories a person can choose from. We configure this list according to current Yale ArchivesSpace instance configuration; therefore it is essentially data with respect to this project. It will be manually updated if any changes happen in Yale's ArchivesSpace repository numbering and naming.

Yale Center for British Art, Institutional Archives
Robert B. Haas Family Arts Library Special Collections

Beinecke Rare Book and Manuscript Library
